# Doxygen Awesome

Vendored from [Doxygen Awesome v2.5.0](https://github.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css/tree/v2.5.0),
commit `46483f1e5a70ffb9ecd3b82d0a1cd1b24edf13da`. The upstream MIT license is in
`LICENSE`. These files are unmodified.

Only the sidebar theme and dark-mode toggle are included. Local styling belongs
in `../../termox.css`. The reference build is pinned to Doxygen 1.18.0, which is
within this theme release's documented compatibility range.
